review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so textual claims and interpretations in the draft could not be verified directly against the code (draft unavailable as noted in prompt instructions).

The full Stata pipeline (approx. 2.5 hours runtime) and 200 GB checksum verification were not run during this review pass; execution behavior was verified through code inspection, static parsing, path resolution, and manifested checksum set comparisons.
External raw census files and intermediate link datasets live outside the repository and could not be inspected directly for record-level content.
summary: Commit 199f386 integrates Section 4.3 (Tables 9–11) into Machine A's replication package and cleanly resolves all three findings from the prior review cycle. The PowerShell driver path formatting is corrected, all 285 newly added inputs are preflighted and registered in the 389-file SHA-256 manifest, and deletion detection for divided-file shards is implemented. The commit introduces no new defects across correctness, replication, claims-vs-code, or identification.

verified_clean.evidence: replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:56 now formats the path argument as literal 'MATCHING\fs_draft_tables.py' without form-feed characters, successfully resolving to an existing file and failing immediately if execution returns non-zero.
verified_clean.item: PowerShell driver script invocation and path syntax

verified_clean.evidence: replication/run_machineA.do:52-61 gathers all three FamilySearch-name link files and iterates over both 1930 and 1940 divided-file directories ('norace*.dta'), testing every input with 'capture confirm file' and bringing the total input count to 389 (390 with -SkipRebuild).
verified_clean.item: Preflight coverage of all Section 4.3 inputs in Machine A Stata master

verified_clean.evidence: replication/input_manifest.md:4-399 records SHA-256 hashes, byte sizes, and timestamps for all 389 inputs (202.9 GB), matching the dynamic list generated by replication/hash_inputs.py:57-79 with zero missing or unexpected files.
verified_clean.item: Complete checksum manifest registration for all 389 inputs

verified_clean.evidence: replication/hash_inputs.py:135-138 computes manifest entries absent from the disk glob ('gone = sorted(set(old) - {short(f) for f in files})') and terminates with exit code 1 if any shard is missing.
verified_clean.item: Detection of removed divided-file shards in input verification

verified_clean.evidence: replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:70-71 and 77 include 'MATCHING/results/fs_avg_performance.tex' and 'MATCHING/results/fs_cells.tex' in the post-run porcelain status check, setting $checkExit = 1 if any number moves.

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:100-153 and MATCHING/fs_cells.do:141-162, 197-206 gate target counts (14,416,543), linkage rates, and validation denominators against published constants to within 1e-9 tolerance, halting with exit code 9 before writing output if numbers diverge.
